Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Dezvoltare de software și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
DevOps Engineer (Security/Monitoring/Reliability)
 Who we are 
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 Work environment 
 Within Financial Processing/Issuing Processing division, platform management team deploy and manage overall the new cloud-based platform for our customers.
 This include :
Build and evolutions of platform infrastructure & services, based on GCP & Private Cloud
Support new customer projects & existing customers on the platform
Provide solution, tooling & automation to internal DevOps squads
Make evolve the platform as per internal strategy, regulation & security standard
 Day-to-Day Responsibilities 
Ensure platform support current and future expectation in term of performance, reliability & security
Identify & qualify point of improvements with expert communities & build improvement plans.
Coordinate improvements plan deployment at platform & software level
Improve observability on platform performance & reliability, identify new approach to improve issues detection.
Implement regular vulnerability & penetration tests & monitor resolution plan
Implement security standard, support internal DevOps squads
Support SRE & service managers to take over and manage the related service
Collaborate and build good relationship with all stakeholders involved: Solution development teams, E2E test team, production support team, Cyber Defense Center, Customer Project teams, management, change & release managers, etc.
 Who Are We Looking For 
 We look for people who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
Broad technical skills (java application development & production support, db, system, network, security) in Cloud based infrastructure, ideally GCP & AWS, and strong experiences in DevOps
Solutions & tooling: Kubernetes, Linux, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MQ, Kafka, Dynatrace, Loki/Prometheus/Grafana, gitlab-ci, Terraform, Puppet, Ansible
Good communication and facilitator skills
Experience in technical project management required
Languages: fluent in English
Supportive, positive, persistent, empathic
 Perks & Benefits 
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career.
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasions of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
